Feature: Interrupts can be generated based on positive edge or negative edge or level high or level low detection at GPIO input.
Test Description: Verify negative-edge interrupt behavior on GPIO inputs and confirm correct group and system status handling across selected pads.
Remarks: Negative-edge mode is used. Pads are tested once each in random order. Build selects the target instance.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the GPIO interrupt source in INTR_EN1.
2) For each unique pad (32 total):
   2.1) Program the per-GPIO control register (GPIO_8 + offset) to input mode with negative-edge interrupt enabled.
   2.2) Enable the corresponding bit in INTR1_INTR_EN1 for that pad.
   2.3) Apply an input transition from high to low and back to high to create a negative edge.
   2.4) Wait until the interrupt has been serviced.
3) In the interrupt service routine for the active pad:
   3.1) Read the per-GPIO register (GPIO_8 + offset) and check that the DIN bit is set.
   3.2) Confirm the raw interrupt status bit in the per-GPIO register is set.
   3.3) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 and confirm the bit for the active pad is set.
   3.4) Disable the group enable for that pad by writing 0 to INTR1_INTR_EN1.
   3.5) Clear the per-GPIO raw status by writing to the per-GPIO register (GPIO_8 + offset), then read back and confirm it equals 0x100001.
   3.6) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 again and confirm it is 0.
   3.7) Clear the system raw status for the GPIO interrupt using gpio_intr_raw_stclr1 and confirm the bit is cleared.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
- DIN bit in the per-GPIO register is set after the negative-edge event; pass when set.
- Per-GPIO raw interrupt status bit is asserted; pass when non-zero.
- INTR1_INTR_STS1 shows the active pad bit set; pass when set.
- After clearing, the per-GPIO register readback equals 0x100001; pass when equal.
- INTR1_INTR_STS1 becomes 0 after clear; pass when zero.
- System raw status for the GPIO interrupt is cleared in gpio_intr_raw_stclr1; pass when readback shows bit=0.

Test Description: Validate that a falling edge on each input pin triggers an interrupt and the associated status and clear operations function correctly. The test iterates through all targeted pins in sequence using a walking zeros stimulus.
Remarks: Interrupt handling is used. Input pins are exercised sequentially using a walking zeros pattern. System interrupt source selection depends on build configuration.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable the relevant interrupt line in the interrupt controller for the selected source.
2) Initialize the error counter to zero.
3) Enable the system-level interrupt source for the selected GPIO instance by writing to gp0_intr2_intr_en1.
4) For each pin index from 0 to 31, program GPIO_8 + (index * 4) with 0x00040000 to select falling-edge interrupt mode.
5) Wait for a short duration to allow configuration to settle.
6) Configure GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP1 with 0x000000FF.
7) Configure GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP2 with 0x000000FF.
8) Configure GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP3 with 0x000000FF.
9) Configure GPIO_IO_CTRL_GROUP4 with 0x000000FF.
10) Wait for a short duration to allow configuration to settle.
11) Enable all group interrupts by writing 0xFFFFFFFF to INTR1_INTR_EN1.
12) For each pin index from 0 to 31, perform the following sequence:
13) Set the external stimulus memory at 0xA0243ffc to 0xFFFFFFFF to drive all pins high.
14) Wait for a short duration.
15) Drive only the current pin low by writing the walking zeros pattern to 0xA0243ffc.
16) Wait for a short duration.
17) Mark interrupt pending and wait until it is cleared by the interrupt handler.
18) In the interrupt handler, clear the pending flag and restore the external stimulus at 0xA0243ffc to 0xFFFFFFFF.
19) Read GPIO_8 + (current index * 4) and verify the input data bit indicates the expected value after the falling edge.
20) Check that the raw interrupt status bit in the same per-pin register is asserted.
21) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verify that the bit corresponding to the current pin is set.
22) Clear the per-pin interrupt by writing 0x00110001 to GPIO_8 + (current index * 4).
23) Wait briefly and read back GPIO_8 + (current index * 4), confirming the expected cleared value 0x00100001.
24) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 again and verify it is cleared (0x00000000).
25) Clear the system raw status corresponding to the selected GPIO instance by writing to RAW_STCR1 and verify the raw status bit is cleared on readback.
26) Clear the interrupt in the interrupt controller for the selected source.

Feature: Interrupts can be generated based on positive edge or negative edge or level high or level low detection at GPIO input.
Test Description: Verify that enabling negedge interrupt on all GPIO pads works, group status asserts on events, and per-GPIO and system statuses can be cleared correctly while inputs are configured via IO control groups.
Remarks: All 32 pads (GPIO[8..39]) are configured for negedge interrupt and input mode. Group interrupt enable is set for all. External stimulus toggles all pads to generate negedge events sequentially.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable GPIO0 or GPIO1 IRQ in GIC (87 or 88).
2) Enable the corresponding system interrupt in LSS SYSREG (INTR_EN1).
3) For i=0..31, write GPIO_8+(i*4)=0x00040000 to enable negedge interrupt per pad.
4) Program IO control groups for input mode: GROUP1..GROUP4=0x000000FF.
5) Enable group interrupt bits for all pads: INTR1_INTR_EN1=0xFFFFFFFF.
6) For each i=0..31: drive 0xA0243ffc to 0xFFFFFFFF, wait; then to 0x00000000 to create negedge; set int_pend=1 and wait for ISR to clear.
7) In ISR: read INTR1_INTR_STS1; verify any bit set; disable group enable (INTR1_INTR_EN1=0).
8) Clear per-GPIO raw status for all pads by writing GPIO_8+(i*4)=0x00110001; wait; verify INTR1_INTR_STS1==0.
9) Clear system raw status in LSS SYSREG RAW_STCR1 for selected GPIO instance; verify cleared.
10) Clear IRQ in GIC (87/88).

Feature: GPIO output mode pad drive verification.
Test Description: Validate that enabling output mode on GPIOs 8–39 drives the pad level correctly high and low per DOUT writes and that the observed pad value matches the expected bit in the stimulus register.
Remarks: No interrupts expected. Pads are toggled high then low using per-GPIO register writes (0x00200000 then 0x00000000), validated by reading 0xA0243ffc.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Optionally enable IRQ line 87/88 (not used by this test).
2) Configure IO control groups for output mode: GROUP1..GROUP4=0x00FF00FF.
3) Enable group interrupt mask (not functionally used).
4) For i=0..31: write GPIO_8+(i*4)=0x00200000 to drive DOUT=1; set gp0_flag_dout_one=1; call check_for_pad_value(i).
5) Wait; then write GPIO_8+(i*4)=0x00000000 to drive DOUT=0; set gp0_flag_dout_zero=1; call check_for_pad_value(i).
6) In check_for_pad_value: read 0xA0243ffc; if gp0_flag_dout_one==1, verify bit i is 1; if gp0_flag_dout_zero==1, verify bit i is 0; on mismatch, increment test_err.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) For each i, after writing 0x00200000, bit i of 0xA0243ffc reads 1; pass if set.
2) After writing 0x00000000, bit i reads 0; pass if cleared.
